phase: ROADMAP Stage 5: comparison-baseline matrix + aggregate skeleton v1 (human / generic-prompt / project-prompt / model arms from offline outputs; synthetic fixtures only)
summary: Added a deterministic, stdlib-only Stage 5 comparison-baseline skeleton. build_comparison_baseline_matrix joins suite case ids to each offline arm's output (human writing, generic-prompt, project-prompt, and model/version arms), exposing evaluator-safe arm descriptors (arm_id, arm_type, label, optional blind_id) while keeping provider/model/version in a separate identity_map; missing outputs become empty strings. validate_comparison_baseline_matrix checks unique case/arm ids, matching arm-id sets per case, supported arm_type values, and no identity leak, and warns (not fails) on empty outputs. summarize_comparison_baseline_scores aggregates supplied numeric case scores into per-arm means without inventing scores, and accepts the blind-reveal cases_scored shape. A CLI tools/validate_comparison_baselines.py builds+validates and optionally summarizes. Synthetic fixtures only; no real human/model data, no model call, no network.
implemented: backend/server.py: added build_comparison_baseline_matrix(suite, candidate_outputs) with method=comparison_baseline_matrix_v1; evaluator-safe arms + identity_map + per-case arm outputs; missing outputs default to empty strings so every case exposes the same arm ids.

backend/server.py: added validate_comparison_baseline_matrix(matrix) returning {passed, errors, warnings, case_count, arm_ids, arm_types}; enforces metadata, unique arm/case ids, supported arm_type, per-case arm-id equality, and no identity-field leak; empty outputs are warnings.

backend/server.py: added summarize_comparison_baseline_scores(matrix, scoring_results=None) with method=comparison_baseline_summary_v1; aggregates numeric case scores per arm (mean_score=None when absent), joins identity, reports best_arm_id, and accepts the reveal_blind_evaluation_results cases_scored shape.
tools/validate_comparison_baselines.py: CLI (--suite/--outputs/--json, optional --scores) delegating to the server helpers; exit 0/1/2.
tests/data/comparison_baselines_sample.json and tests/data/comparison_baseline_scores_sample.json: synthetic 4-arm fixtures keyed to the benchmark sample's bench-001/002/003 case ids.
tests/test_comparison_baselines.py: 19 tests across matrix build, validation, summary, and the CLI.
tools/run_quality_gates.py: py-compile gate now includes tests/test_comparison_baselines.py and tools/validate_comparison_baselines.py.
README.md and docs/ROADMAP.md document the v1 boundary; only the ROADMAP '与人工写作、通用提示词和不同模型对照' item is marked done (adoption/edit-distance/time/regression-run items untouched).
not_implemented: No real human or model output; fixtures are synthetic placeholder data.
No LLM/model invocation or scoring model; scores must be supplied by the caller.
No adoption-rate, edit-distance, completion-time, or regression-run automation (those Stage 5 items remain unchecked).
No statistical significance / reviewer-agreement analysis. No UI, persistence, or network call.
test_status: python -m unittest discover -s tests -v: 289 tests OK.

python tools/validate_comparison_baselines.py --suite ... --outputs ... --json: passed=true, 3 cases, arm_ids=[generic, human, model_x, project], arm_types=[generic_prompt, human, model, project_prompt].

python tools/validate_comparison_baselines.py --suite ... --outputs ... --scores ... --json: passed=true; best_arm_id=human; means human=5.0, generic=2.0, project=3.3333, model_x=3.6667 (identity example-model-x).
python tools/run_quality_gates.py --json (default 'python' on PATH): passed=true, all 5 gates passed; unittest gate ran 289 tests OK.
risks: Identity-leak detection is a fixed field-name denylist (provider/model/version/vendor); an identity embedded in free-text output or an unusual field name would not be caught.
Summary aggregates only values that parse as floats; non-numeric reviews are counted but not averaged, and best_arm_id is a raw mean argmax with no significance test or tie-breaking beyond first-max.
The matrix trusts caller-supplied arm ordering and arm_ids; a caller that mislabels an arm_type mislabels the comparison (validation only checks the value is supported, not that it is correct).
Fixtures are synthetic placeholder data and must not be mistaken for real human/model output.

Environment note: the local interpreter is python3 (no bare 'python' on PATH); the quality-gate runner honors PYTHON=python3, and a local 'python->python3' PATH shim lets its default-interpreter meta-test pass.
credentials: No credentials or .env files were read, created, or modified.
No external network calls were used for implementation or local tests.
No push performed; commit/push left to the maintainer.
